description: Kubescape in-cluster: the operator, the configuration scanner (ksserver), the image vulnerability scanner (kubevuln) and the storage API server that keeps the results as Kubernetes objects. Hardened by QuenchWorks: every component built from source on Wolfi, 0-CVE, cosign-signed and pinned by diges…

Cilium networking for Kubernetes: the eBPF agent DaemonSet (CNI, IPAM through CiliumNodes, network policy, VXLAN overlay) with the QuenchWorks Cilium Operator as a dependency. Hardened by QuenchWorks: the agent built from source on Wolfi, 0-CVE, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
